intent: Must-choose overlay that interrupts until the user cancels or confirms. Composes ModalCard (same header and footer as Modal), with no Close.
useWhen: Confirming a destructive or irreversible action
A decision that must be answered before the page continues
doNotUseWhen: Inline status on the page — use Alert
Dismissible short tasks or forms — use Modal

eyebrow.note: Short area name in the header row, 12px, like Billing · Invoices. Caller-provided.

tone.note: Tone icon (16px, aria-hidden) and status word from KitLabels (info, success, warning, danger) before the eyebrow, so status is never colour alone. neutral shows the eyebrow only.

consequences.note: Outcome lines under the description, as visible text, like Invoices already in the ledger stay.

confirmText.note: The person types this (a name) to turn on the action. The field is labelled Type <confirmText> to confirm; the action stays disabled until it matches, and focus starts in the field.

actionVariant.note: danger replaces the primary. Buttons are size sm.

size.note: Modal sizes: sm 352 (16 padding) or md 448 (24). Radius 16.

footerStart.note: Left of Cancel and the action, first in the footer tab order: an optional Ask Button (appearance outline, mode neutral, size sm, iconStart MessageCircle). Caller-provided label.

passthrough.note: Not the portal or overlay. Focus trap, Escape, scroll lock and focus return are kit-owned.

requirements: Composes ModalCard with role=alertdialog and aria-modal
Title (h2) is the accessible name, description is aria-describedby
Focus starts on Cancel, or in the confirmText field when set; never on the action
confirmText field is labelled, described by a hint until it matches, and aria-invalid on a typo; the action is disabled until it matches
Focus is trapped while open and the page behind is inert
Escape cancels, unless an open panel inside it (Select, DatePicker) handles that Escape first
Scroll lock keeps the scrollbar gutter
Focus returns to the opener on close; if the opener is gone, to the page heading (or main)
built-in labels (dialogActions, warning, danger, info, success) come from KitLabelsProvider; English by default

Below 30rem (480px) it docks to the bottom as a full-width sheet (24 from the sides, 40 from the bottom) with Cancel and the action stacked full width at lg 40, Cancel on top; focus still starts on Cancel

doNot: Do not invent a local confirm dialog or use window.confirm
Do not put forms, tables, or extra actions in AlertDialog — use Modal
Do not add a close X or dismiss on overlay
Do not use more than one primary/danger action (the action button is the one)
snippet: <AlertDialog open={open} size="sm" tone="warning" eyebrow="Integrations" title="Disconnect Stripe?" description="Syncing stops right away. Invoices already in the ledger stay. You can reconnect later." cancelLabel="Keep connected" actionLabel="Disconnect" actionVariant="danger" onCancel={close} onAction={disconnect} />
